newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP June iron ore/coal output down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP June iron ore/coal output down.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Thursday that its Queensland coal production fell one percent in June compared with a year earlier, while iron ore output from Western Australia fell two percent.
Queensland coal production operations totalled 1.877 million tonnes while iron ore production from Western Australia totalled 4.328 million tonnes.

BHP said coal production from U.S. mines was higher due to dragline positioning at the Navajo mine in New Mexico while production in New South Wales rose due to the commencement of full production at the Mount Owen project.
"Coal shipments were lower due to the timing of shipments from Queensland and deferral of shipments from Indonesia partly offset by higher demand for New Mexico coal," BHP said.
The company said iron ore production at the Samarco operation in Brazil was lower due to maintenance at the Germano concentrator and the Point Ubu pellet plant.
Note: June is the first month of BHP's reporting year.
